Bug_Title: Optional value should only be accessed after calling isPresent()
Bug_Explanation: The bug is shown in two methods'showBug' and'showBug2'. In'showBug', the non-compliant line of code is accessing the Optional value without checking if it is present or not. In'showBug2', we are directly calling 'get()' method on the Optional value without first checking if it is present or not.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case triggers the bug by attempting to access an Optional value without first checking if it is present using the isPresent() or isEmpty() method.
